goal: Teach the tactical purpose and an executable technique, rather than describing visible movement.
title_zh: 这一拍想争什么？技术怎么做？
display_label: 战术解读与技术建议｜不是球员意图实测

beats.title: 01  拉开对手，不是比力量
beats.text: 红衣还在后场，可以用短球拉她向前。身前控短要小幅送拍，别大甩手臂。
beats.technique_quote: 身前控短要小幅送拍，别大甩手臂
beats.intent: Use the front space while the opponent has rearward displacement, making her cover longitudinal distance.
beats.technique: For the proposed short shot played in front of the body, use a small controlled stroke instead of a large arm swing. This is advice, not a measured racket action.
beats.cue: 意图：拉她向前｜技术：小幅送拍，别甩大臂
beats.avoid: Do not classify the observed shot as a measured net shot, draw a tracked shuttle path, or claim to know the player's thoughts.

beats.title: 02  解围之后，抢下一次启动
beats.text: 被动救球先争恢复时间。来不及回中也别一直赶路；对手出拍时做分腿垫步，准备再次蹬出。
beats.intent_quote: 被动救球先争恢复时间
beats.technique_quote: 对手出拍时做分腿垫步，准备再次蹬出
beats.intent: Prioritize surviving pressure and restoring the ability to respond, rather than forcing an immediate attack.
beats.technique: Time readiness and a small split step around the opponent's stroke instead of continuing a blind run to the geometric centre. This is a coaching cue, not a claim that the split step was detected.
beats.cue: 意图：争恢复时间｜技术：卡着出拍做启动垫步
beats.avoid: Do not claim measured time gained, an exact airborne interval, joint force, or a detected split step.

beats.title: 03  先恢复，再利用她的前压
beats.text: 弓步接完及时蹬回，别把重心留在跨步上。红衣若继续前压，灰衣可打她身后，逼她转身回追。
beats.intent_quote: 红衣若继续前压，灰衣可打她身后，逼她转身回追
beats.technique_quote: 弓步接完及时蹬回，别把重心留在跨步上
beats.intent: If the opponent continues committing forward, use the space behind her to demand a reversal rather than feed her preferred forward interception.
beats.technique: After the visible low lunge, recover from the extended stance so the next change of direction remains possible. This is advice, not a claim about measured force or centre of mass.
beats.cue: 技术：跨步后蹬回｜意图：利用前压身后的空间
beats.avoid: Frame 16442 is near mid/rear court, not at the net. Do not invoke low-at-net logic. The behind-opponent shot is a conditional option, not the measured actual trajectory or a guaranteed result.

review_limits: This is parent editorial approval to render, not independent expert review, human voice-naturalness review, model acceptance, or user acceptance.
